mapper.delete: delete gsp from goods_sku_price gsp inner join goods_sku sku on gsp.sku_id = sku.f_id where sku.spu_id = #{spuId}
mapper.insert:
insert into goods_sku_price ( f_id, rule_id, sku_id, market_type, sale_price ) values
( #{item.fId}, #{item.ruleId}, #{item.skuId}, #{item.marketType}, #{item.salePrice} )
mapper.select: select sku_id as skuId, market_type as marketType, sale_price as salePrice from goods_sku_price where (f_delete_mark = 0 or f_delete_mark is null) and sku_id = #{skuId} and market_type = #{marketType} limit 1
